artifact_role: Durable record of the owner canonical-acceptance EXECUTION attempt for the five threshold-clearing Batch 07 roots. No canonicalization was performed; no DB row was created or mutated. Governance/evidence only.

owner_decisions_consumed.provenance: Explicit human-owner decisions supplied with the execution instruction. Recorded here as genuine owner input. They are NOT AI-generated semantic verification and could NOT be persisted as repository-native VerificationRecords because no SemanticClaim exists to attach them to (see blocker).

blocker.summary: No repository-native path exists to materialize the file-based Batch 07 research into canonicalizable SemanticClaims, and the databases lack every genuine precondition CanonicalizationPolicy requires. Satisfying them would require fabricating research-runtime controls or re-running the roots through the governed runtime (performing semantic research) — both explicitly forbidden.
blocker.no_native_materialization_path: The only SemanticClaim constructor is backend/domain/services/research_judgment.py::ResearchJudgmentService.create, reachable only via the governed API pipeline POST /runs -> /runs/{id}/blind/preflight -> /runs/{id}/observations -> /runs/{id}/judgments -> /judgments/{id}/verification -> /judgments/{id}/canonicalize. There is NO file->claim/from_artifact/ingest/materialize function anywhere. tools/campaign.py emits only JSON artifacts + ledger + a CampaignState row and hardcodes canonical_authorization=PENDING by design (research/canonicalization separation).

database_scaffolding_genuinely_absent.two_database_split: runtime.db has the corpus (49,968 structural_tokens, snapshot snap_tanzil_1_1_ac0724796cbb) but 0 methodology_revisions; lisanapp.db has the methodology (LISAN_QURANIC_SEMANTIC_EXTRACTION@01784170cac4, CURRENT) but 0 corpus_snapshots/occurrences/tokens. Neither DB alone can host a genuine run.
database_scaffolding_genuinely_absent.snapshot_not_production_valid: snap_tanzil_1_1_ac0724796cbb is validation_status=PENDING / activation_status=CANONICAL_ACTIVATION_PENDING in runtime.db (absent in lisanapp.db); is_production_validated()==False -> CanonicalizationPolicy 'Corpus snapshot is not production-valid'.
database_scaffolding_genuinely_absent.methodology_missing_in_corpus_db: runtime.db methodology_revisions is EMPTY -> 'Methodology revision is missing'.
database_scaffolding_genuinely_absent.no_runs_isolation_observations: research_runs=0, isolation_states=0, observation_artifacts=0, dependency_records=0, semantic_claims=0, verification_records=0 in BOTH DBs.
database_scaffolding_genuinely_absent.occurrences_verse_level_only: corpus_occurrences are verse-level with empty expression (6236 rows); no per-root/per-expression occurrence rows exist, so resolve_evidence_refs cannot resolve 'occurrence:<id>' for a root and derive_completeness finds 0 eligible occurrences per target_expression.
database_scaffolding_genuinely_absent.evidence_format_mismatch: campaign artifacts store bare word_refs (e.g. 20:18:3:1); ResearchJudgmentCreate requires typed 'occurrence:<CorpusOccurrence.id>' resolvable within the run's snapshot.
database_scaffolding_genuinely_absent.universal_coverage_gate: dnw and fwh are UNIVERSAL/ROOT_GENERALIZATION; derive_completeness requires supported_ids==eligible_ids (an ObservationArtifact or supporting-evidence occurrence for EVERY eligible occurrence). The campaign never produced per-occurrence observation rows.

fabrication_that_would_be_required_and_i: ISOLATION (highest risk): IsolationState=CLEAN is an unconditional default with NO enforcement/evidence; auto-creating it asserts a blind-lab isolation guarantee the file campaign never established through the runtime.
PRODUCTION: flipping the PENDING snapshot to VALIDATED/PRODUCTION_ACTIVE (a separate owner-authorized corpus-activation step, not part of 'canonicalize 5 roots').
RUNS/OBSERVATIONS: hand-creating ResearchRun + full-coverage ObservationArtifacts the campaign never produced.
METHODOLOGY: registering/aligning a CURRENT source-bound MethodologyRevision in the corpus DB.
Re-running the roots through the governed runtime pipeline instead would constitute PERFORMING SEMANTIC RESEARCH (forbidden by this task).

investigation.method: 6-way parallel read-only investigation (research-judgment service, API endpoints, canonicalization conditions, both-DB introspection, existing-materialize-path search, corpus/isolation/methodology services) plus direct DB introspection and code reading.
investigation.consensus: Unanimous: no native file->claim materialization path; every canonicalization precondition genuinely absent; canonicalization impossible without fabrication or new research.

negative_controls: Governance suite fail-closed confirmed: 27 tests pass (canonicalization refuses missing/non-INDEPENDENT/stale verification and unauthorized actor; AI has no ACCEPTED transition; steward cannot bypass; research judgment has no canonical authority).
hard_boundaries_honored: No fabricated human decision (owner decisions recorded as supplied).
No fabricated VerificationRecord / ResearchRun / IsolationState / ObservationArtifact / snapshot activation.
CanonicalizationPolicy not bypassed; canonical_state not set by SQL/JSON/ORM edit.
SyH/Twf not canonicalized; no MODERATE/UNRESOLVED root canonicalized.

exact_unblock_options: Owner/maintainer adds a genuine, reviewed repository-native ingestion path that binds frozen campaign research to real production-valid corpus occurrences with authentic isolation/observation evidence (a design change, not this task); OR

Owner authorizes and executes the corpus production-activation of snap_tanzil_1_1_ac0724796cbb and then runs the five roots through the governed research-runtime pipeline (POST /runs -> blind/preflight -> observations covering the full eligible set -> judgments -> INDEPENDENT verification -> canonicalize) — which is a re-execution through the runtime, not reuse of the file checkpoint.
In either case the INDEPENDENT VerificationRecord and TRUSTED_LOCAL_OWNER canonicalization must be performed by the authorized independent/owner actors, not the AI implementation agent.
